title: Paighaame Jari hai yahi
body:
paighaam e jari hai yehi
<<DIVIDER>>
......zari.......
mashkeeza leke nehr se nikla jo alamdar
har simt se hone lagi phir teero'n ki bochhaar
girne lage ghode se to abbas pukaare
aaqa meri ummeedo'n ke sab toote sahaare
shabbir pukaare jo alamdaar ko jakar
shabbir se abbas ye kehne lage rokar par apne kaleje pe na sadme ko uthana
<<MINI>>
aaqa mere laashe ko yahi'n chord ke jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
paighaam mera jaake sakina ko sunana
<<MINI>>
paighaam e jari hai yehi
<<DIVIDER>>
waada tha sakina se mera laaunga paani
aye beti bujhaaungi teri tashnadahani
ab kya karu'n sab lutgaya wado'n ka khazana
<<MINI>>
aaqa mere laashe ko yahi'n chord ke jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu bhi kate saath me jazbaat kate hai'n
mai kaise sahara lu'n mere haath kate hain
marjayegi bachchi usey bazu na dikhana
<<MINI>>
aaqa mere laashe ko yahi'n chord ke jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
baba bhi chale aaye hai'n milne ko najaf se
jab jaaiyega khaime me to phir meri taraf se
pehle to sakina ko kaleje se lagana
<<MINI>>
aaqa mere laashe ko yahi'n chord ke jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
rehwar ko phir mod liya janibe sahil
ummeed meri toot gayi rone laga dil
jab mashk meri bangayi teero'n ka nashana
<<MINI>>
aaqa mere laashe ko yahi'n chord ke jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
poochhe jo sakina mujhe kehna mere aaqa
kuch kehke tasalli usey dena mere aaqa
fouran na meri mout ka ahwaal sunana
<<MINI>>
aaqa mere laashe ko yahi'n chord ke jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
pohnchaunga paani mai ye koshish to badi thi par kya karu ke mout mere aage khadi thi
chaha tha dil o jaan se waade ko nibahna
<<MINI>>
aaqa mere laashe ko yahi'n chord ke jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
bazu bhi qalam hone ka ahsaas nahi hai
gham ye hai mujhe paani mere paas nahi hai
mashkeeza na bach paaya bohat chaha bachaana
<<MINI>>
aaqa mere laashe ko yahi'n chord ke jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
kahiyega sakina se mujhe muaaf karegi
wo pyaasi hai iski mujhe takleef rahegi
mai kya karu'n mumkin hi nahi paani pilaana
<<MINI>>
aaqa mere laashe ko yahi'n chord ke jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
kahiyega qalam hogaye jab bazu hamare
ek teer laga aankh me par aake hamare
is bekasi me mera zamee'n par huwa aana
<<MINI>>
aaqa mere laashe ko yahi'n chord ke jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarah likhu'n karb mai abbas ka aalam
shabbir bhi rone lage karne lage matam
abbas ko chaha jo kaleje se lagana
<<MINI>>
aaqa mere laashe ko yahi'n chord ke jaana
